approvers: Main contractor / client would have to agree; I decide alone otherwise
reason: I spend about 1,800 a year on snagging damage, and you want 19 euro a m2 which is 19,000 on a 1,000 m2 year. That is ten times my loss, and the main contractor is not paying me extra to protect glazing.
objection: The price is ten times what damage costs me. Nobody pays me for this, so it comes straight off my margin, plus a 150 m2 minimum and a 50% deposit.
instead: Keep doing nothing, fix or replace at snagging from contingency, and maybe use cheap tape or film on the few risky jobs.
would_change_my_mind: The main contractor putting it in the tender as a paid line, or a price near 3 euro per m2 all-in.
